payload.description_html: 1922 New Year's Card by Charles R. Knight. Whimsical depiction of dinosaurs pulling and riding on a cart, on which rests a structure reading "New Building", presumably referencing expanding the American Museum of Natural History's dinosaur exhibit to larger quarters.
